montego.label: Downtown Montego Bay
montego.note: Confirm gallery opening, then give the public waterfront time. These are choices within a downtown day, not a promise of an inspected pedestrian route.

montego.label: Choose a hillside experience
montego.note: Reserve the garden visit and check the actual transfer to your meal. Rocklands is an alternative, not an automatic extra stop.

negril.label: Negril beach
negril.note: Choose a beach block and a meal at Miss Lily’s if its service and access fit. Protect the beach time; a separate West End evening requires another transfer.

negril.label: Lucea and Hanover history
negril.note: Arrange a Lucea town/fort visit, then a Hanover coastal meal at Half Moon Beach if the driver confirms the transfer. This is Green Island, not the Rose Hall Half Moon resort.

portland.label: Portland coast
portland.note: Choose a beach block and a meal if your host confirms the route and timing. Reach Falls is a separate active alternative.

portland.label: Living Maroon heritage
portland.note: Arrange a host and programme. A Rio Grande raft trip is another possible day, not an assumed part of this community visit.

capital-mountains.label: City art and music
capital-mountains.note: Choose one museum for a half-day; a longer city day can include a second museum only after checking tours and traffic. Gloria’s Seafood City is the downtown waterfront branch, not Port Royal.

capital-mountains.label: A separate mountain day
capital-mountains.note: Confirm road and weather conditions, chosen Holywell trail and Blue Brews service. The cafe advertises weekend public service and weekday group bookings; arrange both park entry and food. Holywell is not the Peak trek.

southeast.label: Morant Bay history
southeast.note: Arrange a locally informed daytime route and pickup. Read the rebellion article before the outing.

southeast.label: Bath branch
southeast.note: Confirm the actual establishment and service. This is a separate branch, with no promised treatment benefit.

south-elizabeth.label: Treasure Beach at a local pace
south-elizabeth.note: Choose a bay, a meal and time in the community. Offshore boats need separate booking and conditions checks.

south-elizabeth.label: Black River and food
south-elizabeth.note: Confirm the river departure and your driver’s route to the food stop. YS Falls is a different main-outing alternative.

central-interior.label: Mandeville town
central-interior.note: Plan a town-centre history visit and time for a meal. Alligator Pond is a separate coastal branch.

central-interior.label: A second Manchester learning day
central-interior.note: Choose the Alligator Pond coastal branch only with confirmed restaurant access and transport. Spanish Town is an alternative base/branch, not the assumed next stop from Mandeville.
